name: Unwed Mothers
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of honoring and valuing the role of mothers, as seen in commands to honor parents and heed their instruction (Deuteronomy 5:16; Proverbs 1:8). The nurturing and training of children in godly ways is a sacred responsibility, promising lasting impact (Proverbs 22:6). The character of a virtuous woman, marked by strength and honor, is celebrated with hope for rejoicing in the future (Proverbs 31:25). God’s comforting presence is likened to a mother’s tender care (Isaiah 66:13), and even Jesus Himself demonstrated respect and submission to His mother (Luke 2:51), underscoring the dignity and worth of mothers in God’s design.
